correctness.rationale: On an unrestricted frame, at depth one a root and fresh directional neighbours realize arbitrary prescribed colour sets and characteristic formulas separate them. At depth two every edge contributes the root's colour in the reverse direction at the neighbour, so the stated condition is necessary. For sufficiency, use a distinct neighbour for each (relation, direction, listed type), attach it to the root by that one edge only, and use a single shared auxiliary world of each colour to supply missing colours for each neighbour in each direction. No auxiliary edge touches the root or another designated neighbour, so sharing cannot add an undesired colour at a constrained world. This proves the size bound even for empty sets and p=0 (with standard Boolean truth constants). Each direction independently permits exactly t_1/2 types at a fixed root colour, giving t_2=m2^(r t_1). Diamonds and boxes distinguish every profile and induction on formulas shows each depth-two formula is constant on each profile. Thus the Boolean algebra is the power set of all t_2 profiles. In the independent-modal comparison every one-step type can be supplied by a fresh neighbour without any required reverse colour; this gives m2^(2r t_1), including the stated 16 versus 256 example. With one proposition and one pair, t_1=32 and t_2=2^33. The source checker was inspected but not executed; the general consistency and count use the finite-model construction.

value.rationale: Depth two is precisely where treating inverse modalities as independent first changes the semantic types. The result identifies the full obstruction at that boundary, gives a directly usable small satisfiability witness, and quantifies the loss of formal profiles exactly, which mere local tabularity cannot do. The exact census and witness are useful here independent of any extension to larger depths.
